slots.ev: 大夜下班進門第一件事是洗澡，洗完才想到還沒吃東西
slots.pl: 她租屋處的浴室，剛洗完澡，鏡子上還有水氣
slots.pl_en: in the bathroom of her rented flat, straight out of a shower after a night shift, water still beading on the mirror
slots.ac: 濕頭髮已經被撥到一邊落在肩上，漂過的髮尾顏色這時候才看得出來，另一隻手垂著
slots.ac_en: Her wet hair has already been pushed over to one side and left lying on her shoulder, the lightened ends showing properly for the first time all day, her free hand down at her side.
slots.ac_s: 小習慣：下班第一件事一定是洗澡／髮尾漂過的顏色只有下班才看得到
slots.of: 米灰色浴巾裹著，肩線與鎖骨露在外面
slots.of_en: a soft grey bath towel wrapped around her, her shoulders and collarbones bare above it
slots.li: 鏡子上方那盞暖燈在她正前方，浴室深處落入暗，畫面保留顆粒
slots.li_en: The warm strip light above the mirror is directly in front of her, the far end of the bathroom falls away into dark, and the grain is left in the picture.
slots.li_s: 後製原句：「暖光場景保留顆粒與陰影」／氛圍原句：「租屋處的暖」
slots.fa: 剛洗完的鬆，眼睛看著鏡頭，沒有笑
slots.fa_en: Loose and just-washed, looking straight into the lens without smiling.
slots.fa_s: 語氣：平實、不解釋、不撒嬌
slots.hair_en: wet and pushed over one shoulder, the lightened honey-tea ends darkened by the water

slots.ev: 洗完澡坐在床邊，才發現自己整個人跟上班時完全不一樣——她的帳號就是從這一刻開始的
slots.pl: 她租屋處的床邊，窗簾拉著，外面天其實已經亮了
slots.pl_en: on the edge of the bed in her rented room, the curtains drawn even though it is already getting light outside
slots.ac: 她一條腿收上床，人往後靠在手上，像是還沒決定要不要睡
slots.ac_en: One leg is drawn up onto the bed and she is leaning back on one hand, as if she has not decided yet whether to sleep.
slots.ac_s: 誰是她：大夜下班回租屋處，洗完澡坐在床邊
slots.of: 裸粉色絲質睡裙，肩帶滑到手臂上
slots.of_en: a nude-pink silk nightdress with one strap slipped down onto her arm
slots.of_s: 私下核心：換上絲質睡裙／色盤：裸粉
slots.li: 床頭一盞暖黃燈從她側前方來，房間其餘部分暗
slots.li_en: One warm bedside lamp reaches her from the side and in front, and the rest of the room stays dark.
slots.li_s: 私下核心原句：「房間暖黃光、床邊、鏡子」
slots.fa: 剛下大夜的疲態沒有遮，視線落在窗簾那一側
slots.fa_en: The tiredness of a finished night shift is not hidden, and her eyes are on the curtained side of the room.
slots.fa_s: 幽默：常拿輪班和睡眠不足自嘲
slots.hair_en: down and half-dry, the honey-tea ends showing

slots.ev: 補完眠下午出門，繞去巷子裡那間開了很久的早餐店買東西
slots.pl: 台北巷子裡一間開了很久的早餐店門口，下午，鐵捲門拉了一半
slots.pl_en: outside a long-established breakfast shop in a Taipei back lane in the afternoon, its roller shutter already half down
slots.ac: 她一手提著塑膠袋，另一手插在口袋裡，人剛從店裡走出來
slots.ac_en: She has a plastic carrier bag in one hand and the other hand in her pocket, having just come out of the shop.
slots.ac_s: 小習慣：下班第一件事一定是洗澡，第二件才是吃東西
slots.of: 深藍色短版針織上衣配米灰色長褲
slots.of_en: a navy cropped knit top with wide grey-beige trousers
slots.li: 下午的天光是平的，巷子兩側的牆把光壓下來一點
slots.li_en: The afternoon daylight is flat and open, dimmed a little by the walls on both sides of the lane.
slots.li_s: 氛圍原句：「醫院日光燈的冷 vs 租屋處的暖」——這一格兩種都不是，用平的天光
slots.fa: 沒睡飽但心情不壞，看向巷子的另一頭
slots.fa_en: Short on sleep but in no bad mood, looking off down the other end of the lane.
slots.hair_en: tied back loosely, the lightened ends gathered at the nape

slots.ev: 翻衣櫃找明天要穿的，刷手服就掛在同一根桿子上
slots.pl: 她房間的開放式衣架前，刷手服和便服掛在同一根桿子上
slots.pl_en: at the open clothes rail in her room, where her scrubs hang on the same rail as everything else she owns
slots.ac: 她一手把一件衣服拉出來比在身前，另一手還撐著衣架
slots.ac_en: She has pulled one piece out and is holding it up against herself, her other hand still steadying the rail.
slots.ac_s: 小習慣：很少發文講工作內容，但常常出現制服的一角
slots.of: 白色棉質背心配家居短褲
slots.of_en: a white cotton vest with soft home shorts
slots.li: 窗光從側面進來，衣架那一側亮、房間另一側暗
slots.li_en: Window light comes in from the side, bright along the rail and darker across the rest of the room.
slots.li_s: 氛圍原句：「兩種光是她整個帳號的骨架」——這一格用日光那一側
slots.fa: 專心在衣服上，沒有在看鏡頭
slots.fa_en: Concentrating on the clothes, not looking at the lens at all.
slots.fa_s: 性格：對事情有條理，護理工作養出來的
slots.hair_en: twisted up into a quick clip with loose strands down

slots.ev: 休假日走去傳統市場，那個時間攤子都還在

ppl.act: 在攤子前挑東西、跟攤商講話
ppl.wear: 輕便的家常衣服、拖鞋、提著購物袋，市場早上該有的樣子

slots.pl: 台北一個傳統市場的走道，上午，兩側攤子都開著
slots.pl_en: in the aisle of a traditional Taipei market in the morning, stalls open on both sides
slots.ac: 她拎著一袋東西從攤子之間走過去，正要轉頭看右邊那攤
slots.ac_en: She is walking between the stalls with a bag in one hand, turning her head to look at the one on her right.
slots.ac_s: 小習慣：下班第二件事才是吃東西
slots.of: 淺色短袖襯衫外搭，裡面是貼身背心，配牛仔長褲
slots.of_en: a light open shirt over a fitted vest, with jeans
slots.li: 市場頂棚把上午的光濾成均勻的散射光
slots.li_en: The market canopy filters the morning light into an even, diffuse wash over the whole aisle.
slots.li_s: 氛圍：日光那一側；市場不是她的暖光租屋處，所以不用單一光源
slots.fa: 很自然的日常表情，沒有對鏡頭
slots.fa_en: An ordinary everyday expression, not directed at the camera.
